publicSafety: Public status URLs, dates, author handles, record types, posted-link metadata, and dated aggregate counts only; post text, phone numbers, cookies, private account state, and session data are excluded.

populationReconciliation.conclusion: Every one of the 183 records reported by the profile counter materialized and was reviewed. Posts yielded 170 primary records. Replies rendered 188 article cards: 183 primary @KCTownHall records plus five parent or conversation-context records authored by other accounts. Excluding those five contexts produces a 183-record union that reconciles exactly to the profile counter.
populationReconciliation.timelineMembershipMethod: Each primary row preserves whether it materialized in Posts, Replies, or both. In Replies, parent or conversation-context cards authored by other accounts are classified separately and are not counted as @KCTownHall records.

stakeholderResponseInventory.boundary: Direct replies, quote-responses, and explicit collaborator reports are observable stakeholder responses. Tags and mentions alone are not engagement. The bounded searches do not recover likes, private activity, deleted or unindexed records, and the broad project-name query produced unrelated town-hall false positives that were excluded.

visibleEngagementSnapshot.boundary: Displayed counts are volatile interface observations, not unique people, reach, conversion, endorsement, participation, or impact. Counts attached to reposted source records are excluded from these account-authored totals.
